summary: Free Hugging Face course that teaches you to build AI agents, from the basics to a certified final project.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: This repository holds the Hugging Face Agents Course. It is divided into four units that take you from the basics of agents to a final assignment with a benchmark, plus bonus units.
sixtySeconds.problem: Learning to build agents means piecing together scattered tutorials. This free course gives a structured path with hands-on frameworks and a certificate project.
whoFor: Anyone curious how AI agents work
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a free, well-organised course from Hugging Face covering smolagents, LangGraph and LlamaIndex, with a final evaluated project.
requirements: A free Hugging Face account to sign up

overview: Units: 0 welcome and tools, 1 introduction to agents, 2 frameworks (smolagents, LlamaIndex, LangGraph), 3 a use case for agentic RAG, and 4 a final project to create, test and certify your agent.
Bonus units cover fine-tuning an LLM for function calling, observability and evaluation, and agents in games with Pokémon.
Sign-up is free. The course content is Apache 2.0 licensed and contributions such as typo fixes are welcome.
limitations: Assumes basic Python and LLM knowledge
